title: Iran's FM Spox. Esmaeil Baqaei:
text:
Iran's FM Spox. Esmaeil Baqaei:"

"There is no provision titled “60-day deadline” in the text of the memorandum of understanding. "

"The Islamic Republic of Iran never formulates its policies under pressure, ultimatums, or time deadlines."

"What was stipulated in the memorandum was merely a 60-day period for discussions on two issues: “lifting sanctions” and “the nuclear issue.” "

"If no result was reached, this period could be extended."

"Due to the gross and widespread violation of the June 18 memorandum of understanding by the United States only a few weeks after it was signed, no talks were ever initiated. "

"Consequently, the issue of a 60-day deadline became entirely moot."
